title: Order row
description: One order as the `orders` topic, the History pages and the details carry it. Money is a decimal string. `status` is the lifecycle only; 'partially filled' is derived from `filled`. Mirrors src/panel/model/frames.ts (OrderRow). See decision 0007 part 2 §9.1.

closedBy.description: A4: paired filled order ids, all partners; never inferred by a page read.

closed.description: A4: paired filled order ids, all partners; never inferred by a page read.

seq.description: The ledger event id of the row's last change. A row applies only if its seq is newer than the one held.

requestId.description: The form's command id, until the row replaces the form's pending state.

removed.description: Added 2026-10-10 (0003b amendment 3 d1, rulings 339 and 413.3): the row's account is being removed from gcx or was removed with its trading history kept; the row takes no action. Absent otherwise.

account.description: Added 2026-10-10 (0003b amendment 3 d1): with `removed`, the account's name (shown "<name> (Account removed)"), since its row in the accounts list is gone.

cloid.description: The client order id gcx journals before sending. A venue order without it was placed outside gcx.

imported.description: 0004 amendment 3 d7: an order placed outside gcx that gcx took into its book on a change, for its whole life (its id stays ext:<the venue's order id>). Absent otherwise.

change.description: Added 2026-10-18 (MH 726 (e)): the last change a request asked for since the runtime started (a modify, a take-profit or stop-loss edit) and how it ended: `applied` once the exchange took it (or at once when nothing rests there to change), `reverted` when the exchange refused it and the order is back as it was, `failed` when the order went into repair. Absent while the outcome is not known, for an order nobody changed, and after a restart. The panel's snackbar waits for its own request's.

cancelOnly.description: 0004 amendment 3 d3: an order placed outside gcx that gcx can cancel but not change as it was placed (a take-profit trigger, a position TP/SL, a grouped leg, another copy's order): no pencil, no Modify. Absent otherwise.

changedAt.description: Optional C52 last admitted own display change, in epoch milliseconds; never a ledger sequence.

chartAlgo.description: Optional factual legacy DCA exec_inst equivalence from generated-order membership or its actual iteration bracket; not inferred from a row botId label.

gridStart.description: A grid's start order: bought or sold at once at the price, its limit only the grid's edge it may not pass; the chart draws its fills, not a line at that edge. Absent on every other row and on older runtimes.

chartSeq.description: Optional visual-facts revision; includes indexed related-child changes without changing order state.

modifyChainId.description: Shared by every order of a modify chain; the list keys the row by modifyChainId, else id.

unarmed.description: Added 2026-10-18 (MH 728 (a), 729 (b)): a take-profit or stop-loss leg whose parent order has not filled in full: a plan, nothing of it on the exchange. The lists leave it out (Open orders and History); its parent's details show it. Absent once the parent has filled, and from older runtimes (an older panel lists the leg as before).

plannedExits.description: Added 2026-10-18 (MH 729 (r) (a)): on a parent order that ended (cancelled) before it filled in full, how many take-profits and stop-losses it had planned; their legs are `unarmed` and no list rows, so History's +TP/+SL tags read this. Absent on every other row, and from older runtimes.

restOf.description: Added 2026-10-05 (0026 d5): a send of an order's rest, shown as its own row with the id `<order id>:rest<k>` (k = 1, 2, …): the order's id, which an action on the row acts on. Its size, fills, average and fee are that send's; the order's first row (its id) is its sends before the first rest. A person's take-profit or stop-loss keeps its role; a bot's rest is role and type `exit`. Absent on every other row, and from older runtimes.

role.description: liquidation and adl (added 2026-10-05, decision 0016 Amendment 3 d4): in a bot's activity, its share of an order the exchange filled, with `whole`.

level.description: The averaging level when role is avg.

botId.description: Set on a bot-owned order: the list offers the bot, not Cancel.

type.description: liquidation and adl (added 2026-10-05, decision 0016 Amendment 3 d4): a fill the exchange made, one closed row per account and venue order (id `liquidation:<sourceId>:<venue order id>`), with `botsShare`.

status.description: Never moves backwards; a backwards upsert is refused and reported.

reason.description: Why an order is unknown, rejected or failed to trigger. On a closed order whose `closeReason` is `rejected`, the exchange's own words unchanged (the raw message; absent for an order never placed or unfilled, where the exchange said nothing). On an order in repair: the engine's code, or, when the exchange refused the order and gave words (a take-profit, a stop-loss, a fired stop, an error gcx does not recognise), those words unchanged, or, when the exchange cancelled it, its cancel reason (`margin`, `liquidation`, `venue`); `why` is then our explanation (before 2026-10-05, ruling 203, always the code).

why.description: An order in repair: the repair as a sentence for the person, the text the notification says (when the exchange refused the order in words goodcryptoX named, its error type instead, ruling 203; when goodcryptoX refused it itself, `refusalBy` is `gcx` and the sentence says the order was never placed, ruling 570), in the person's language (the `language` setting; English when none is chosen or the language has no text for it). Absent when the order is not in repair. Added 2026-10-05 (ruling 203): also on a closed order whose `closeReason` is `rejected` (refused by the exchange, never placed, or unfilled): our explanation of the error, goodcryptoX's error type for the refusals it named, else the generic one; before it, such a row had no `why` and a reader ignores it.

refusalBy.description: Added 2026-10-16 (ruling 570): on a closed order whose `closeReason` is `rejected`, `reason` is goodcryptoX's own words, not the exchange's: it refused the order before signing it (an instrument it does not trade, a market order it could not price because the book could not be read) or could not sign it; the words start "not sent: ". Also, since the same day (batch-533-578 finding 1), on an order in repair (`status` `unknown`) whose `reason` is such words: a stop that fired and could not be priced. Absent (the default, and on every older row): `reason` is the exchange's words. A reader that does not know it shows `reason` as before.

repairCause.description: Optional factual engine REPAIR code, such as failed-to-trigger after a definite venue refusal or unknown after an ambiguous send. Display metadata only: status, actions and retries keep their lifecycle meaning. Absent when not in REPAIR and on older rows; absent readers keep the previous presentation.

nativeTriggerState.description: Optional positive venue phase of the native stop's current attempt, read from the incremental accepted-event index, seeded by the place reply and promoted by fills. A subsequent triggered account-stream update for an already accepted attempt does not update this fact. Display metadata only; no change to engine state, actions or retries. Absent on older records or without a supported positive fact; readers retain the existing fallback.

custody.description: internal: a trigger gcx watches and sends itself.

resting.description: In the venue's book now (venue truth). The order book dots show resting orders that are not triggers.

triggerPrice.description: Absent until a trailing order with an activation price is active.

waitingTriggerPrice.description: Current admitted stop seed while waiting for trailing activation, including waiting distance edits. The immutable initialTriggerPrice keeps its creation meaning. Absent after activation and on older runtimes; not an active path sample.

held.description: A send gcx holds for the person (0013 ruling 1; status sending): why, only for an order that opens or adds to a position. stopped: gcx stopped before sending it (the next start sends it); disk: the disk is full; maintenance: Hyperliquid was in maintenance when it was due (it goes by itself when the maintenance ends). POST /api/v1/orders/{id}/send-now sends it, cancel ends it. Added 2026-10-04; absent on older rows and on every send not held.

waiting.description: Added 2026-10-05 (0003 Amendment 2 d2, d8): rate-address, Hyperliquid's request allowance for this order's account is used up, and the order (or its cancel) waits its turn: the account sends one action every 10 seconds, in the order they were made. Nothing is refused; Cancel removes a waiting order at once. Added 2026-10-05 (0003 Amendment 3 d5): upgrade-gate, Hyperliquid takes only post-only orders for a few minutes after its upgrade; the order waits and is sent again every 10 seconds until taken (no `ahead`). Absent otherwise and from older runtimes.

ahead.description: With `waiting`: how many of the account's actions go before this one.

trailAnchorPrice.description: Optional admitted trailing distance basis: current engine extreme while trailing, configured Start or recorded placement price while waiting. Display only; never inferred from rounded stop or current tick. Absent on older runtimes.

improveOnlyPrice.description: Latest admitted waiting improve-only activation, updated by accepted waiting edits and retained after trailing begins. Display only; absent on older runtimes or ordinary trailing orders.

trailStart.description: Original configured trailing Start from the admitted order state. null positively means Auto; absent means unavailable on an older runtime or not a trailing order. Independent of computed activationPrice.

improveOnly.description: Actual manual trailing improve-only state, when available.

trailPhase.description: Engine-recorded trailing phase; absent on older runtimes.

trailStartedAt.description: Display-only timestamp of the admitted wait-to-trail activation output for the current trailing revision. Later stop moves retain it; re-arming removes it. Absent for immediately trailing orders and older runtimes; never inferred from a path point or creation time.

trailStartedPointId.description: Display-only id of the admitted trail point that began the current trailing revision, disambiguating activations with the same timestamp. Re-arming removes it. Optional on older runtimes and absent for immediately trailing orders; never authorizes an action.

firedAt.description: The engine-recorded trigger timestamp, when one exists; absence is not an inferred trigger.

expiresAt.description: Time in force as a duration (decision 0004, catalogue P11): when the order is cancelled, milliseconds since the epoch.

size.description: In the base asset; absent when the order was sized in quote (cost).

builderFee.description: Added 2026-10-17 (0004 amendment note): the part of `fee` that is gcx's platform fee (the fills' builder fee, valued as `fee` is), so the exchange's own part is `fee` − `builderFee`. Absent when none of the row's fills names one (a fill recorded before it was kept, or one the venue charged none on, such as a spot buy); `fee` is then the whole fee.

trailGain.description: Added 2026-10-28 (0040 amendment 6): on a grid's trailing exit, its own `gain` as the grid row's `trailing` sums it; what it earned against a limit at its level (`price`) = trailGain + the maker rate × price × filled. Absent on every other order and from older runtimes

createdAt.description: Milliseconds since the epoch. An exit leg nothing has sent yet carries its parent's (a take-profit or stop-loss of an order the person made) or the time its position's take-profit and stop-loss were attached.

placedAt.description: A bot's take-profit, stop-loss or level re-sized or re-levelled by a later send of the same order: when the latest of those sends went (ms). The chart starts the order's line there, as goodcryptoX drew each re-size's new order (MH 285). Absent before such a send, on a person's order and from older runtimes: the line starts at createdAt.

closedAt.description: When the order closed (ms): closed by its fills, the exchange's time of its latest fill (0016 amendment 5; recorded before it: when gcx recorded it); a liquidation or ADL row, its last fill's exchange time; an earlier send of a rest series, when its next send left; any other close (a cancel, a refusal), when gcx recorded it.

whole.description: Added 2026-10-05 (decision 0016 Amendment 3 d4): on a bot's liquidation or adl row, the sum of the sizes of the fills it was charged in; `size` below it is shown "Partially attributed".

botsShare.description: Added 2026-10-05 (decision 0016 Amendment 3 d4): on a liquidation or adl row, what the bots on the coin were charged of it, net (each bot's held size × the fill ÷ the exchange's net position, a bot on the other side counting against; MH 214 (b)); the rest is the person's. Absent when no bot was charged.

decimal.description: A plain non-negative decimal string. Never a JSON number.

signed.description: A plain decimal string, negative allowed. Never a JSON number.
